# Creating a compute machine set on Azure Stack Hub {#creating-machineset-azure-stack-hub}

You can create a different compute machine set to serve a specific purpose in your OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ azure_first }} Stack Hub. For example, you might create infrastructure machine sets and related machines so that you can move supporting workloads to the new machines.
